title: Feedback on reputation cost from failed checks was inconsistent at the same spot: the first failed attempt at each of the two glade options named a specific faction hit; the next two failed retries of the same action reported no reputation change at all ('It can be tried again.'); the eventual successful roll then cost reputation again despite succeeding. Never explained whether repeat failures compound a hidden penalty.
